name: City of Reno Junior Lifeguards
org: City of Reno Parks and Recreation, Aquatics
what_you_do: Take a four day junior lifeguard class for ages 11 to 14. You earn Red Cross CPR/AED and first aid certification, valid for two years.
who_can_apply: Ages 11 to 14 by the first session date. You must pass a swim test: 25 yards of front crawl, a step into deep water with a 10 foot underwater swim, and 1 minute of treading water.
deadline_text: The 2026 sessions listed are Oct 5 to 8 and Dec 28 to 31. No registration deadline is stated.
how_to_apply: Pick a session on the program page. Each session links to a registration page, and the site has an Online Registration link. For questions, call Parks Administration at 775-334-2262.
notes: This is a good step toward the City of Reno lifeguard class, which starts at age 15. You must attend every day of a session to be certified.
